name: Bhilangna House
description: The Bhilangna is one of the most famous and popular rivers in India. It is one of the Himalayan Rivers in Uttarakhand, India. Bhilangna, rises at the foot of the Khatling Glacier (elevation 3,717 m (12,195 ft)) approximately 50 km south of the ice cave at Gaumukh, traditionally considered the source of both the Bhagirathi and the Ganges and flows into the Bhagirathi at Old Tehri, the site of the Tehri dam. The Bhilangna River meets the main tributary, the Bal Ganga at Ghyansali with the height of 976 meters.
